CoreDhristi is building a global marketplace for AI agents, automations, and developer-built AI systems.

We are creating a trusted ecosystem where companies can discover, evaluate, license, and work with AI solutions built by developers worldwide. Our platform combines marketplace infrastructure, security scanning, licensing, payments, developer tools, AI-powered experiences, and a hiring ecosystem for custom AI development.

We are building a product where **security, trust, developer experience, and real-world usability matter as much as the features themselves**.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Full Stack Developer** to join our team **on-site in Indore**.

This is not a role limited to frontend UI or simple CRUD development. You will work across the stack and contribute to real product systems involving marketplace workflows, authentication and authorization, payments, APIs, database architecture, security tooling, developer tooling, AI-powered features, and third-party integrations.

You will work closely with the founder and the wider product, design, and security functions to build, improve, test, and maintain CoreDhristi as we move toward our public launch.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain responsive, production-quality interfaces using **React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and modern frontend practices**.

Develop and maintain backend services, API routes, business logic, integrations, and data flows using the **TypeScript/Node.js ecosystem**.

Work with **GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines** to improve development, testing, security checks, and deployment workflows.

Build integrations with GitHub and other external services used throughout the platform.

Improve performance, reliability, scalability, observability, and maintainability across the application.

Write clean, modular, testable code and participate in code reviews, debugging, technical discussions, and documentation.

Help improve internal developer tooling and the overall engineering workflow.

**Frontend:** Next.js 16, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

**Backend:** Next.js App Router / TypeScript server-side APIs

**Database:** PostgreSQL + Prisma

**Authentication:** NextAuth, OTP, 2FA, RBAC

**Developer tooling:** GitHub integrations + CoreDhristi CLI

2+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on full-stack experience.

Strong proficiency in **JavaScript/TypeScript and React**.

Solid experience with **Next.js** and modern web application development.

Good understanding of backend development, API design, authentication, authorization, and server-side application logic.

Good understanding of Git, GitHub, debugging, testing, and collaborative software development.
